name: pc-control
description: Windows PC control bundle: real-time batched GUI automation, screen-share frame caching, animated border-ring input lock with Ctrl+C abort, window management, diagnostics, networking, power tuning, and maintenance.
author: Aaditya Sharma
suggestedPrompts: Run a full PC health check on my CPU, RAM, disks, drivers, and recent system errors
Diagnose my Wi-Fi connection and check my current power plan and battery settings
Take a screenshot of my desktop and list all currently open windows
